title: A smaller Llama and a JSON-capable text generator
summary:
New text options joined the model list while request routing and image queue waits got a tune-up.

Added `llamalight` (Llama 3.2 3B Instruct) and an Azure-backed `gpt-4o-mini-roblox` generator with JSON-mode support. The listed Llama 3.3 70B chat and Llama 3.1 completion options were removed.

OpenRouter requests now use the specified model instead of always using DeepSeek Chat. Requests over the existing per-IP queue limit return a structured JSON 429 error; text requests also emit analytics events.

The image queue wait changed from 500 ms per queued item to a fixed 500 ms. Image failure logging and text integration tests were also updated.

highlights.title: Llamalight joins text models
highlights.text: Use `llamalight` for text generation with Llama 3.2 3B Instruct. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=llamalight).

highlights.title: JSON-capable GPT-4o mini
highlights.text: Generate text with `gpt-4o-mini-roblox`, including JSON-mode responses. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gpt-4o-mini-roblox).

highlights.title: Shorter waits in image queues
highlights.text: The image queue's wait is now a fixed 500 ms instead of growing by 500 ms for every queued item. [Try image generation](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
